article.story: OTTAWA, Ontario -- — Shane Pinto scored the shootout winner to give the Ottawa Senators a 3-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Saturday night. Tim Stutzle and Drake Batherson — who tied it with 2:23 left in the third period — scored for the Senators (4-1-0). Linus Ullmark turned away 16 shots. Jonathan Marchessault and Ross Colton scored for Nashville (2-1-2), while Matt Murray made 18 stops. The Predators took a delay-of-game penalty for a puck over glass with 13 seconds remaining in regulation providing the Senators the perfect opportunity, but a stagnant power play was unable to capitalize. Ottawa went 1 for 6 with the man advantage. The game ended a three-game Eastern Canada trip for the Predators. Defenseman Jayden Struble made his Nashville debut. He was acquired Friday from the Montreal Canadiens. Up next Predators: Host Vegas on Tuesday night. Senators: At New Jersey on Monday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
